name: Tree
usage: Team hierarchies, folder trees, permission trees

props.name: options
props.description:
The nodes: `key`, `title`, `children` and `disabled`. Nodes may carry other fields; callbacks such as `onDrop`
receive the original objects.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Called with the keys of the expanded nodes when a node is expanded or collapsed.

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Keys of the nodes selected at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the keys of the selected nodes when a node is selected or unselected.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Shows a checkbox before each node, for checking several nodes (such as a permission tree).

props.name: checkedKeys
props.description: Keys of the checked nodes (controlled); only with `checkable`.

props.name: defaultCheckedKeys
props.description: Keys of the nodes checked at first (uncontrolled); only with `checkable`.

props.name: onCheck
props.description: Called with the keys of the checked nodes when a checkbox changes.

props.name: blockNode
props.description: Nodes fill the width of the tree, so the whole row can be clicked.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Nodes can be dragged to another place in the tree; handle the result in `onDrop`.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Called when a dragged node is dropped. The tree does not move the node itself: update `options`.

props.name: testId
props.description: Test hook, rendered as `data-testid` on the tree.

types.name: TreeDropInfo<T>
types.summary: What happened when a node was dropped onto another node in a draggable Tree.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The node it was dropped on.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Where it was dropped: `inside` the target (as a child), or in the gap `before` / `after` it (as a sibling).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Expand and select nodes; the arrow keys move between nodes.

examples.name: Checkable
examples.title: Checkable
examples.description: `checkable` checks several nodes, as in a permission tree.
